about.title: A small family operation that grew across the Gulf Coast
text: Quik Marine Services began in 2018, born from a hardworking Houston family with deep roots in the maritime industry. What started as a small, family-run operation grew across the Gulf Coast.
Our crew has years of hands-on experience in port operations, cargo coordination and marine logistics.
When you call, you get real people, not layers of delay or excuses. Every vessel, crew and operation gets the same care we give our own family.
